worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.summary: Confuse a nearby target, making its actions liable to fail or hurt itself. Higher friendship extends the duration.
worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.use.1: Open a miss window before an ally's focus fire
worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.use.2: Break up an opponent's combo in a grapple
It only lands within kissing distance (%1$s blocks, scaled by body size); with the current form that distance is %2$s blocks. Out of reach it simply misses, at no PP cost.
A kissed target is left confused for %1$s: each action may be wasted, and a landed hit turns its own force back on it. Higher friendship means a longer daze and more hearts left on it (%2$s).

Leaning in and delivering the kiss takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. The kiss is a choice: a Light kiss is quick and has a x0.9 cooldown but x0.8 confusion; a Deep kiss adds +6 ticks of wind-up, +4 of recovery and x1.15 cooldown, buying x1.3 confusion and +1 severity.
worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.preference.k: Light: quick wind-up and x0.9 cooldown, but x0.8 confusion duration — good for repeated close-range pokes. Deep: +6 ticks wind-up, +4 recovery and x1.15 cooldown, buying x1.3 duration and +1 severity — good for locking one target down in melee.
worldcombat.skill.sweetkiss.preference.a: The partner only considers closing in while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it in melee, larger lets it chase out.
Anytime: close in and kiss any threat. When bitten: kiss only right after the partner is hit, as payback for whoever came close.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to kiss.
